title: Smart devices and cameras in practice
intro: Who is your camera filming for?. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.prompt: You are signing in to the camera panel for the first time. What do you do on this page?
decisions.explain: This is the camera's own address on your home network. Change the password right after the first sign-in.

decisions.title: Körpə Gözü: Live view from a new device

artifact.title: Körpə Gözü: Live view from a new device

decisions.explain: First see what is happening in your own app.

decisions.title: Default password in use

artifact.title: Default password in use
body: Change the password now for your security.

decisions.explain: Changing the default password is the single most important step for a camera.

decisions.title: Guest network: Home-Devices
decisions.prompt: Is this setting safe or a threat?

artifact.title: Guest network: Home-Devices
body: Camera, TV and robot vacuum are here. Phones and laptops stay on the main network.

decisions.explain: Even if a weak device is hacked, it cannot reach your phone or computer.

decisions.title: Router: UPnP
decisions.prompt: Is this setting safe or a threat?

artifact.title: Router: UPnP
body: On. Devices can open ports by themselves.

decisions.explain: This feature lets devices open doors on their own. If you do not need it, turn it off.
